name: h100-sxm
description: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 80 GB as installed in Oxford ARC HTC htc-g059/060 (8 per node, NVLink4 NVSwitch). Roofline fields from the datasheet (dense BF16 989 TFLOPS, HBM3 3.35 TB/s, 80 GB); the profile bundle used with this spec (profiler/perf/H100) is measured on that node type by the LLMServingSim profiler, so runs on it carry the bundle's own provenance, not this roofline's. workspace_gib is to be set from a vLLM bench run of the same model/TP with serving/tools/workspace_from_bench.py (hardware validation tier 3); until then the instance's mem_util applies.

compute.model: time = max(flops / (peak * achieved_fraction), bytes / hbm_bandwidth) + kernel_floor

notes: 80 GB = 74.5 GiB nominal; vLLM reports 79.6 GiB usable on these boards (check meta.json hardware.total_memory_bytes and correct here). NVLink4: 18 links x 25 GB/s per direction = 450 GB/s per GPU per direction, modelled by configs/fabric/custom{2,4,8}_nvswitch_h100.
